description: MDB: Two separate ADO Connections (cn1, cn2) on the same file: (1) cn1 BeginTrans + UPDATE row 1 + INSERT row 5 -> cn2 forward-only, keyset & static visibility; cn2 same-row UPDATE, same-page UPDATE (row 2), keyset edit row 2 Update, and other-table T2 UPDATE (control); cn1 RollbackTrans -> cn2 retry UPDATE row 1 succeeds. (2) cn1 BeginTrans + UPDATE row 3 + INSERT row 6 + CommitTrans -> cn2 visibility at 0ms, stale keyset edit row 3 Update (3197), Requery, and fresh cn3 read. Keeps all pages at every boundary.
